integrity: The earlier combinatorial type list and the two-valued face-vector distribution are explicitly credited; the claimed contribution is the conditional equal-Haar-mass split. The probability is established analytically; finite computation is a check. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only Haar-uniform central sections of the symmetric four-cube, excluding exceptional normals of measure zero; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Three equiprobable combinatorial types of Haar central four-cube sections
